purposePage.promise: 5% of each traveler's booking supports social work in Nepal, across more than one field.
purposePage.heroLead: The operator’s promise, said in public. Five percent of each traveler’s booking supports social work in Nepal. The work is not one field. It is more than one. The share leaves with the booking.
purposePage.s1Sub: Five percent leaves with the traveler. It is not a second ask.
purposePage.s1P1: When you book with OutdoorKing, five percent of that booking is set aside for social work in Nepal. The share belongs to the booking itself. It is not a box to tick once the journey is designed, and it is not a separate appeal after the days are drawn.
purposePage.s1P2: We say this as the operator of the journey. The percentage is how the booking is made, for each traveler, before anyone walks a trail. The journey can be short or long. It can be a city, a river, or a high route. The rule does not change with the shape of the days: five percent of each traveler’s booking supports social work in Nepal.
purposePage.s1P3: You do not add it at the end. You do not choose a campaign on this page. The commitment is already in the booking you make with us.
purposePage.s2Sub: The country you travel is the country the share is for.
purposePage.s2P1: The promise names one country. Five percent of each traveler’s booking supports social work in Nepal. It is not described here as support that might land somewhere else, and it is not a fund with a rotating list of places.
purposePage.s2P2: That matters because the booking and the work name the same country. You come for the high valleys, for Kathmandu, for the rivers at the edge of the plains. The share stays with social work there.
purposePage.s2P3: This page keeps the promise at that scale, and only that scale: the percentage, the traveler’s booking, and Nepal.
purposePage.bandLead: Every booking we take carries that share. It is not a line we add when a journey is famous, and it is not a line we drop when the route is quiet.
purposePage.s3Title: The country this promise is spoken into
purposePage.s3Sub: Ridges, a city, a lowland river. The ground the journeys cross.
purposePage.s3P: These photographs are Nepal as the routes move through it. They are not pictures of the social work, and they are not a record of what the five percent has done. They are here so the promise has a place you can stand in — more than one kind of country, inside the one country the booking names.

purposePage.s4Sub: The share is not collapsed into a single cause.
purposePage.s4P1: Social work in Nepal is wider than one kind of help. “Across more than one field” is part of the promise, not a softer way of saying one project. The five percent is not assigned, on this page, to a single heading.
purposePage.s4P2: We keep it at that width on purpose. Each traveler’s booking supports social work in Nepal across more than one field, so the commitment is not narrowed to make the sentence easier. The fields are more than one. The country is Nepal. The share is five percent of the booking.
purposePage.s4P3: That is as specific as this promise gets, and it is specific on purpose: a percentage, a traveler’s booking, a country, and work that is not confined to one field.
purposePage.s5Sub: It does not switch on for one departure and off for another.
purposePage.s5P1: The promise follows each traveler’s booking. A solo guest, a couple, a family: the share is five percent of that booking. It is not a flat gift attached to one famous route, and it is not reserved for a single season.
purposePage.s5P2: It is also the same promise from one journey to the next. Wherever in Nepal the days are drawn — a short walk near the city, a river at the edge of the plains, a high route — the booking still supports social work in Nepal, across more than one field.
purposePage.s5P3: We do not publish a trip price on this page. The figure that belongs here is the share.
purposePage.s6Title: Design the journey. The share comes with it.
purposePage.s6Sub: Five percent of each traveler’s booking supports social work in Nepal, across more than one field.
purposePage.s6Lead: If you design a trip with OutdoorKing, read this page as part of how the journey is booked. The share is already in it.
